verdict.rationale: Extend issues Bearer-token API keys from Developer settings. Test-mode keys are isolated from production data and webhooks, multiple workspaces can separate environments, and the MCP server lets you limit available tools. Together these give coarse environment- and tool-level restriction, but nothing documents per-key permission scopes. missing for 10: per-key permission/resource scoping, agent-specific credential issuance, documentation of RBAC applying to API keys, key expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
